title: Ecological Flow Study of the Gorge Section of Yongding River Based on Hydrological Methods
content:
ABSTRACT

To ensure the sustainable development of the Yongding River Basin and determine its suitable ecological flow values, this study focused on the gorge section of the Yongding River and analyzed six representative hydrological calculation methods, including the Tessman, Texas, and Lyon methods. The calculations were collected at the Yanchi Hydrological Station between 1983 and 2023. The results were evaluated from two aspects: water demand and hydrological rhythm, ultimately identifying the best method for calculating the suitable ecological flow and the corresponding ecological flow values for the gorge section of the Yongding River. The results show that the ecological flow variation occurred in 2000, dividing the study period into a natural phase (1983–2000) and a human-impacted phase. The Lyon method demonstrates good water demand satisfaction and a strong correlation with the natural hydrological rhythm (R = 0.973), making it the most appropriate method for determining the ecological flow values in the gorge section of the Yongding River. The values were determined to range from 4.05 to 9.86 m3/s (Natural phase). The findings provide a scientific foundation and technical support for the ecological scheduling of water conservancy projects in the Yongding River.
